'''Arzhura''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal who was imprisoned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], Arzhura was freed from imprisonment, and started selling [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arzhura appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Armor Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was removed from the game along with the rest of the Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
